root.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Declined: Weinsbach Defense
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. e4 dxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. f3 e6

overview: After 4.f3 Black plays 4...e6 rather than taking the pawn again, so that 5.fxe4 regains material and White gets a big centre. Black usually pins with ...Bb4 and White replies Bd3, when ...Nxe4 or ...Bxc3+ lines (the Pfrang Gambit) become sharp. White has a space and development edge but little real attack; I am not sure of the details.

white_ideas.idea: Recapture on e4 and build a centre with Bd3, Nge2 or Qf3
Use the open f-file and kingside pieces for an attack
Offer the e4 pawn in the Pfrang line for a lead in development

black_ideas.idea: Pin with ...Bb4 and trade bishop for knight
Develop and castle before White's attack builds

typical_structures.structure: Open lines after ...Bxc3+ bxc3 with weakened white queenside

character.notes: Open, tactical, with White developing quickly and Black in the pinning lines having real counter-chances.

gambit.notes: Black declined the second pawn; 5.fxe4 regains material. The Pfrang line sacrifices one later.

soundness.notes: Declined lines are fine for Black, and White's centre is playable; I read it as sound but unclear.

structure.notes: Centre pawns exchange and the position opens.

approach.notes: The BDG family is rarely played by strong players.

level.notes: Needs concrete tactical knowledge but no deep theory.

sublines_that_differ.name: Pfrang Gambit
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. e4 dxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. f3 e6 5. fxe4 Bb4 6. Bd3 Bxc3+ 7. bxc3 Nxe4 8. Be3
sublines_that_differ.how: White sacrifices a pawn for development; this is where material actually changes hands.

character.reason: Open lines and early pins in a BDG-style centre.

gambit.reason: Black has declined and material is level after 5.fxe4, although the Pfrang line gives a pawn.

soundness.reason: White is slightly worse at worst; no outright refutation.

structure.reason: Pawns come off and files open quickly.

approach.reason: BDG family is seldom played by strong players.
